opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students from low‑income households who are not eligible for tuition fee support from the Scottish Government and meet residency and enrolment criteria.
opportunities.summary: Supports tuition fees for eligible undergraduate students in academic year 2026‑27, up to £1,820 per year.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie Masters Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Low‑income Scottish households, ordinarily resident in Scotland, with a place on an eligible taught or research master’s programme beginning in 2026/27.
opportunities.summary: Provides financial support for postgraduate master’s study, up to £5,000 per year, for eligible students.
